patterns.description: Bare fossil resource/column names from the Atomic CRM fork (contacts, companies, deals, tags, ...). Lifted verbatim from Story 1.1's AC-14 word-boundary grep.

exemptReasons.location, contacts, responsiveness: public.shadchanim.contacts is a genuine MyShadchan column (a shadchan's own phone/email, jsonb, 01_tables.sql — that file carries the same word and is already in exactFileAllowlist above) — not the fork's retired contacts table. Story 8.2's column-list grant on 06_grants.sql has to spell the column by name; the phrase is specific to that grant's own column list so it cannot mask an unrelated fossil sharing a line with it.

patterns.description: camelCase/PascalCase compounds of the fossil vocabulary a word-boundary grep on the bare word would miss. Lifted verbatim from Story 1.1's AC-14 second grep.

Every spelling of the retired sales/Sale family (renamed to members) — deliberately a bare, case-insensitive substring, not word-bounded: a word-boundary form misses sales_id, salesId, SalesCreate, useGetSalesName, CURRENT_SALE_CACHE_KEY.

exemptReasons.wholesale: English word that merely contains the retired stem; never an identifier.
exemptReasons.supabase/migrations/20260727122733_renam: The rename migration's own immutable filename, quoted verbatim by scripts/check-wave-ownership.test.mjs to prove a migrations glob overlaps a timestamped file; supabase/migrations is deliberately outside scanPaths because applied history cannot be renamed.

patterns.description: The retired children resource in its SQL/route/dataProvider contexts. Deliberately not a bare "children" word — that also matches React's children prop everywhere.

exemptReasons.p_existing_children_note: Story 5.2: create_shidduch()'s parameter for the SUGGESTED PERSON'S own prior children (a shidduch fact), not the retired `children` resource, which is now `singles` (AD-23).
exemptReasons.existing_children_note: Story 5.2: shidduchim column for the suggested person's own prior children — see above.
exemptReasons.no key beyond resource/id/children/class: RecordLink.test.tsx's closed-prop-list test title; `children` here is React's own prop, one of RecordLinkProps' five legitimate keys.
exemptReasons.\"resource\" | \"id\" | \"children\" | \: RecordLink.test.tsx's ExpectedKeys union, which must spell React's `children` prop literally to assert RecordLinkProps has exactly those five keys.

patterns.description: Child/Children as a bare word or compound identifier (isChildVisibleState, selectedChildId, ChildSwitcherPill, ...). Case-sensitive so it doesn't drown in React's own `children` prop.
